notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
A bit over a year ago Replicated was released. In this update 10 new levels have been added with a gameplay twist. You can access these through the LEVEL SELECT menu.
In many ways I feel this turned out much better than the original. I hope you will like it too!

notes.title: Fixed Level 29
notes.notes: Level 29 now should only have one solution now.

notes.title: Update of Tutorial
notes.notes:
Shortened the tutorial so after the fifth level it automatically
skips to level 11. Levels 6 to 10 can be accessed through LEVEL SELECT.

notes.title: Replicated is released!
notes.notes:
It is 25% off for the first week after launch.
Further updates, milestones (if we hit any) will be posted here, also on my twitter @f_bruno_f

You can post bug reports on the community discussion page.

Enjoy the game!
